edges.mechanism: Cholinesterase inhibition plus choline precursor loading raises brain acetylcholine more than either alone; add-on alpha-GPC 1200 mg/d slowed cognitive, functional and behavioural decline vs donepezil alone.
edges.evidence: ASCOMALVA double-blind RCT (interim, n=113), Korean RCT (n=119), MA of 4 RCTs (cognition MD 1.72); a Korean CDM cohort found no benefit in AChEI users; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Same rationale as donepezil (precursor loading + reduced ACh breakdown); additive cholinergic effects expected for rivastigmine/galantamine though only donepezil was tested clinically.
edges.evidence: Clinical data limited to donepezil; extrapolation to class is mechanistic; combination safety not systematically reported

edges.mechanism: Opposing pharmacology: alpha-GPC reverses scopolamine-induced amnesia and partly restores brain ACh in rats; anticholinergic burden independently associated with dementia risk and may blunt any benefit.
edges.evidence: Animal studies plus MA of anticholinergic burden; no human interaction study; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Alpha-GPC antagonised scopolamine amnesia and scopolamine-induced fall in hippocampal/cortical ACh in rats; may reduce scopolamine's central effects.
One month of GPC 1200 mg/d did not restore pyridostigmine potentiation of GHRH-induced GH in anorexia nervosa; no adverse interaction reported.
edges.evidence: Small human study (n=6 patients); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Co-administered for 12 months in vascular cognitive impairment; no efficacy gain and good overall safety, adherence to nimodipine low.

Prescribed alpha-GPC associated with higher 10-year incident stroke (matched aHR 1.43, dose-response); proposed TMAO mechanism. Confounding by indication likely; an MCI cohort showed lower stroke risk in non-progressors.
edges.evidence: Korean nationwide cohorts (n=12,008,977; n=508,107); observational; low certainty

edges.mechanism: GPC-derived choline is converted by gut microbes to TMA/TMAO; GPC promoted atherosclerosis in ApoE-/- mice; plasma TMAO associated with MACCE (HR 1.67) and mortality in MA.
edges.evidence: Mouse study, human crossover PK showing TMAO rise, TMAO-outcome MAs; human GPC outcome data lacking; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Food-level intake (<=203.7 mg/day) judged safe by EFSA including pregnant/lactating women; pharmacological doses (600-1200 mg/d) unstudied in pregnancy. Maternal NOAEL 1000 mg/kg in rats.
edges.evidence: Regulatory novel-food opinion and animal teratogenicity data

edges.mechanism: True physiological rise: water-soluble choline supplements including GPC rapidly increase plasma TMAO (not seen with egg-PC); one RCT found no significant rise at 480 mg choline-equivalent.
Alpha-GPC raises plasma free choline (peak 0.25-4 h depending on route) and betaine; relevant when measuring choline-pathway biomarkers.
Acute cholinergic stimulation of GH: GH rose 60 min after 1000 mg GPC and GHRH-stimulated GH response was augmented; no post-exercise GH difference at 315-630 mg.
edges.evidence: Small crossover studies; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Overlapping choline donors (duplicate choline and TMAO load); alpha-GPC yields higher plasma choline than citicoline and was superior on SCAG in dementia MA; no combination study. Stacking concern is mechanistic inference.
edges.evidence: PK comparison, rat transporter study, MA of 3 RCTs; mechanistic inference for combination

edges.mechanism: Mechanistic inference: GPC-derived choline is oxidised to betaine, and betaine supplementation produced a borderline TMAO rise; both feed the choline-betaine-TMA/TMAO pathway.
edges.evidence: Human PK/supplementation studies; no combination study; mechanistic inference

edges.mechanism: Mechanistic inference: carnitine is also converted by gut microbiota to TMAO, so stacking adds TMAO precursor load. In a donepezil add-on RCT, the acetyl-L-carnitine/ginkgo arm performed worse than the alpha-GPC arm.
edges.evidence: Human tracer study for carnitine-TMAO; head-to-head RCT arm comparison; mechanistic inference for combination

edges.mechanism: Mechanistic inference: huperzine A is a natural acetylcholinesterase inhibitor with RCT evidence in AD; the ChE-I plus choline-precursor rationale from ASCOMALVA would apply. No combination study.
edges.evidence: Mechanistic inference from huperzine MA and ASCOMALVA

edges.mechanism: APOE e4 non-carriers had better word-recall response to 1200 mg/d choline alfoscerate than carriers in amnestic MCI.
edges.evidence: Single open-label study (n=50); very low certainty
